Package io.webagent4j.workflow

package io.webagent4j.workflow
Deterministic, sequential workflow orchestration over the existing action pipeline: typed variables, masked secret inputs and outputs, small declarative conditions, and structured fail-fast results.

Workflow is an immutable, reusable definition built through Workflow.Builder; WorkflowEngine executes it against explicit WorkflowInputs and returns a structured WorkflowResult. Execution is strictly sequential, always on the calling thread, fail-fast on the first failed step, and never retries a step. This package intentionally does not implement loops, branching graphs, parallel execution, persistence, scheduling, or any scripting/expression language - see docs/workflow.md for the complete contract, secret-masking security boundary, and non-goals.

    IWorkflowActionFactory<R>
    Builds a fresh IPreparedAction for one action-backed workflow step.

    IWorkflowVariables
    Read-only view of the variables available at one point during workflow execution, handed to condition evaluators (IWorkflowCondition) and action factories (IWorkflowActionFactory).

    Workflow.Builder
    Mutable builder for Workflow.
    WorkflowActionSummary
    Restricted projection of an ActionResult for one action-backed workflow step.
    WorkflowBranchSelection
    Backend-neutral label for one branch of a WorkflowStepType.CONDITIONAL step, used in two distinct contexts that never mix: as an actual runtime decision - which branch one specific execution selected, see WorkflowExecutionNode.branchSelection() - or as a purely structural label - which of the two potential branches a WorkflowPlanBranch represents in a WorkflowExecutionPlan, before any execution exists and without predicting one (see docs/workflow.md#execution-plan).
    WorkflowConditionResult
    Safe, structured outcome of evaluating one step's IWorkflowCondition, explaining why a step was executed or WorkflowStepStatus.SKIPPED.
    WorkflowConditions
    Factory for the small, fixed set of declarative IWorkflowConditions Phase 0.8 supports.
    WorkflowEngine
    Deterministic, single-lane executor for Workflow definitions.
    WorkflowExecution
    Bundles one WorkflowEngine.executeWithTree(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call's existing flat WorkflowResult together with its WorkflowExecutionTree - both built from the exact same single execution pass, never a second one.
    WorkflowExecutionNode
    One node of a WorkflowExecutionTree: the same immutable WorkflowStepResult already produced during execution - shared, not recomputed or duplicated (see docs/workflow.md#execution-tree) - together with, for a WorkflowStepType.CONDITIONAL step, which branch was actually selected and that branch's own execution nodes, in execution order.
    WorkflowExecutionPlan
    Immutable, deterministic, backend-neutral description of what a Workflow is structurally capable of executing - built entirely from its definition, without ever running it (see WorkflowPlanner.plan(Workflow) and docs/workflow.md#execution-plan).
    WorkflowExecutionTree
    Immutable, hierarchical view of one workflow execution's actual control-flow path, built once, during that same execution - see WorkflowEngine.executeWithTree(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) and docs/workflow.md#execution-tree.
    WorkflowFailedException
    Optional exception-style projection of a structured, failed WorkflowResult.
    WorkflowFailure
    Safe, structured overall failure reason for a WorkflowStatus.FAILED WorkflowResult.
    WorkflowFailureType
    Stable categories for a workflow-level failure.
    WorkflowId
    Stable, human-readable identifier for one Workflow definition.
    WorkflowInputs
    Immutable, explicit set of input values supplied to one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
    WorkflowInputs.Builder
    Mutable builder for WorkflowInputs.
    WorkflowOutputs
    Immutable set of variables produced by a workflow execution's steps, exposed through WorkflowResult.output(WorkflowVariable).
    WorkflowPlanBranch
    One structurally possible branch of a WorkflowStepType.CONDITIONAL WorkflowPlanNode - part of the workflow's static shape, not a runtime decision (see docs/workflow.md#execution-plan for the distinction from WorkflowExecutionNode, which represents only the one branch an actual execution selected).
    WorkflowPlanner
    Builds a WorkflowExecutionPlan from a Workflow's own already-validated static definition - a dedicated planner, kept separate from WorkflowEngine, so that planning (structural analysis) and execution (running real steps) never share a code path (see docs/workflow.md#execution-plan).
    WorkflowPlanNode
    One node of a WorkflowExecutionPlan: a purely structural, backend-neutral description of one IWorkflowStep as declared in the workflow's definition - never what an execution actually did (see WorkflowExecutionNode for that) and never a prediction of what a runtime-dependent step will do.
    WorkflowPlanOutput
    Backend-neutral, static description of one WorkflowPlanNode's declared output - never its runtime value, which does not exist until a real execution actually publishes it.
    WorkflowResult
    Immutable, structured outcome of one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
    WorkflowStatus
    Overall terminal outcome of one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
    WorkflowStepId
    Stable, human-readable identifier for one step within a Workflow.
    WorkflowStepResult
    Immutable, safe, structured outcome of one IWorkflowStep within a WorkflowResult.
    WorkflowSteps
    Factory for the built-in IWorkflowStep kinds this module supports.
    WorkflowStepStatus
    Terminal outcome of one IWorkflowStep within a workflow execution.
    WorkflowStepType
    Broad category of one IWorkflowStep, for safe diagnostics.
    WorkflowValidationCode
    Stable category for one WorkflowValidationDiagnostic, one per structural invariant Workflow.Builder.build() enforces - see docs/workflow.md#validation-report.
    WorkflowValidationDiagnostic
    One safe, structured explanation of why a Workflow definition violates a structural invariant - see Workflow.Builder.validate() and docs/workflow.md#validation-report.
    WorkflowValidationOutput
    One structurally valid declared output found while validating a Workflow definition - see Workflow.Builder.validate() and docs/workflow.md#validation-report.
    WorkflowValidationReport
    Immutable, deterministic, backend-neutral explanation of a Workflow definition's static properties, produced without ever executing anything - see Workflow.Builder.validate() and docs/workflow.md#validation-report.
    WorkflowValidationSeverity
    Severity of one WorkflowValidationDiagnostic.
    WorkflowVariable<T>
    Typed key identifying one workflow variable by name, runtime type, and sensitivity.
    WorkflowVariableMissingException
    Thrown by IWorkflowVariables.require(WorkflowVariable) when the requested variable has no value at the point of the call.
